featured_reviews.name: Jyotsna Kanal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across a post by Jyoti Travels while desperately trying to get my mom, aunt, and uncle back to Mumbai from Dubai after they were stranded due to the recent air strikes in the UAE.

Even though I contacted them after work hours, the call was answered promptly by the owner, who assured me someone would reach out shortly. Within minutes, Simran called and very patiently reassured me that she would try her best to get them onto the next available chartered flight.

In the meantime, my uncle managed to secure tickets for a flight the following afternoon through another source. Despite the fact that we weren’t giving them any business, Simran continued to stay in touch.

She helped us at every step, followed up at odd hours to keep checking if they managed to reach airport on time, whether the flights were on time, looking up their details to check if their names actually featured on the passenger list, kept checking if they boarded and followed up until they safely reached India

At a time when we were anxious and unsure about the situation on the ground, her constant reassurance and guidance meant more than words can express.

Deeply grateful to Jyoti Travels and especially to Simran for going above and beyond to help us — even when there was absolutely nothing in it for them. That kind of kindness and professionalism is rare. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Every evening /morning instructions given by our Team Leader.   He  also answered our queries.   Sorted out issues.

I understand time is of the essence.  But a little extra time should be given to purchase souvenirs, gifts, etc for family and friends back home.
The only free time given was at Medjugorie which assisted us for extra prayer,  confession,  writing petitions and giving donations for Masses and praying at the Weeping Statue.

Food was good and substantial.  The soups served at the Medjugorje hotel will forever linger in our hearts and minds.  So delicious and fulfilling.
Customer service at its best.

But the food served on the cruise ship at Ancona to Split.... was horrible and very poor and rude service.   Clear instructions not given.  A better food package should have been chosen by Gilanneric Tours even if it meant an increase in the tour price.  The Riya Tour group (Bangalore group) received a better dinner meal and continental breakfast.

Overall the food served at the various restaurants /eateries was good.  Ambience in the restaurants good too.   Clean and hygienic too.

Many were unhappy two days of the Tour were cancelled... no reason given.   Our coach  driver, Bobo, has great driving and parking skills.   He was picking up his next tour group at Slovakia
and he stated no problem with coaches.

A good group, every member helping the other.
Commenced the day with a prayer.
Covered centuries of history,  culture, arts and crafts, architecture whether Gothic, Baroque, Renaissance, Roman, etc. cuisine,  drawings, writings, music, as relayed by the knowledgeable Guides that took us back in time..... So fascinating...history at its best.... !
All in all an enjoyable tour.

From an ardent traveller BERNICE D'SOUZA.

We had planned our Umrah trip recently and opted for the Aala package from Atlas Tours, expecting a comfortable and well-organized experience. Unfortunately, our experience was far from satisfactory.

No one came for cleaning unless we repeatedly called the housekeeping department. The air conditioning was another major issue — it would switch off on its own for long intervals and could not be controlled. The only positive aspect was the hotel - Azka Al Safa’s proximity to Haram, around a 10-minute walk.

The food quality was highly disappointing. No water bottles were provided, there were water jugs and glasses kept, the fruits and salads were stale, and the food served was tasteless and occasionally spoiled. Even after complaining there were no actions taken by the coordinators.

Our experience in Madinah was equally poor. Upon arrival, despite our group including elderly travelers, the coordinator, Mr. Asif, refused to provide room keys until after dinner. After a six-hour journey, this was extremely inconvenient and insensitive. The food served that day was spoiled and inedible. The hotel, Durrat Al Madinah, was in terrible condition — dirty washrooms, broken fittings, and overall unhygienic surroundings.

On the day of departure from Madinah to Jeddah, we were handed biryani packets early in the morning for lunch later in the day. The quantity was insufficient, and the quality was poor. At the airport, the bus driver was rude and unhelpful, refusing to assist even the elderly with their luggage.

Additionally, the Ziyarat in both Makkah and Madinah was scheduled too early in the morning (7 AM), making it extremely difficult for elders.

Overall, the entire experience with Atlas Tours was disappointing. The focus seems to be solely on collecting money rather than providing quality service. Based on this experience, I would not recommend Atlas Tours to anyone planning their Umrah.

featured_reviews.name: Raghunandan Adgaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We travelled on a Northern Lights tour with VOYAAH in November 2025.
Initially, the group size was around 15 people; however, due to sudden cancellations, the group reduced to only 6 participants.
We are fully aware that the package price offered was calculated based on a larger group size and was extremely competitive compared to the market. Operating the tour with only six guests would have been economically unviable for most operators. However, honoring the commitment made by Sharmishtha Ma’am, VOYAAH ensured that the tour operated smoothly and without compromise—and it turned out to be a wonderful experience.
Everything promised in the itinerary was 100% delivered. In fact, because of the smaller group size, we were able to visit several additional places that were not originally part of the itinerary, which added great value to the experience.
Although there was no dedicated tour manager due to the small group size, the driver-cum-guide, Mr. Manveer, was extremely cooperative, courteous, and knowledgeable. He ensured our comfort throughout the journey and made the experience enjoyable.
The hotels provided were all 4-star properties such as Radisson Blu and Crowne Plaza, located in the city center. This allowed us to experience the local vibe and nightlife comfortably.
There were some issues during the last two days due to miscommunication between vendors; however, these were later resolved satisfactorily by the VOYAAH team.
Daily lunch or dinner arrangements were made at Indian restaurants, as per our preference, which was greatly appreciated. The vehicle provided for the tour was also in very good condition.
From the beginning, Mr. Mayank Singh, Marketing Executive (Mumbai), ensured seamless coordination for visa processing, tour-related information, and other arrangements, which made the pre-tour experience smooth and stress-free.
One area where VOYAAH can improve is communication during the tour. Having a dedicated single point of contact throughout the journey would help in addressing both minor and major concerns more efficiently, as the driver-cum-guide did not have decision-making authority and had to depend on instructions from the Bangalore/Mumbai office.
Overall, it was a very memorable and enjoyable experience. Despite operational challenges, VOYAAH stood by their commitment and delivered an excellent tour.
I would definitely recommend VOYAAH for international tours and look forward to engaging with them again for our future travels.
Thank you, VOYAAH team!

We saw lions in double digits lounging like royalty, elephants commandeering the savanna highways, giraffes gracefully ambling across the landscape, and yes, we even saw a real “zebra crossing”!

Our guide John was knowledgeable and passionate, sharing fascinating insights about the ecosystem and local culture. He was an absolute superstar with an uncanny ability to spot a leopard at 200 meters. We encountered not one but two elusive leopards, proving that even the most camera-shy cats can’t resist a good photoshoot when the lighting is right!

We really appreciate how Bhakti and her team went the extra mile to make our special family occasion even more memorable. Her team outdid themselves by meticulously planning and executing the celebration with energy and care. Kudos to Bhakti and the whole Eastern Travels team!

Between witnessing the Great Migration’s drama, learning traditional fire-starting (harder than YouTube makes it look), and understanding why cattle equal currency, we gained new perspectives on how to elevate the art of living authentically.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin (सचिन भागवत)
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a fraud company. Not worth of one star also. They are just advertising transparent service, in reality they will keep you in the dark about your hotel bookings and other itineraries till the last day.

They promise you something and then they are not providing what they promised saying we can only provide this much and last moment you can't do anything. They will say they will book premium services, VIP tickets,  all inclusive tickets which they mentioned on their website while booking and also charge you heavily on the name of VIP, premium, all inclusive booking, in reality they will book a standard and basic tickets which doesn't include whatever they mentioned in your itinerary while booking.

While booking the tour they will accept booking amount by credit card and while making the remaining payment they will ask for an additional 3.5% for credit card payments.

I had booked a trip to Abu Dhabi and Dubai during Diwali with them. I made a booking in the month of July. Then I didn't hear anything regarding my itinerary, bookings. When I tried to contact them to make sure they have booked whatever they have promised, nobody was responding. Then I contacted top management and was  surprised with their response which was so rude and unprofessional. They said since it's Diwali they have very limited staff and have to handle a large number of bookings so you cannot expect a response to your queries, which was a really unprofessional attitude.

We were two adults and one child of 8 years and while booking we made them clear that we will be requiring a separate bed for the child. Accordingly they charged us. In reality they booked an additional bed at Abu Dhabi but not in Dubai. When we reach Dubai, the hotel asked us to directly make payment while on tour in forex for which we have already paid to Tratoli. They also charged us for attractions which were under maintenance.  They made a WhatsApp group one day prior to the travel date stating that "This WhatsApp group will be your main point of communication throughout the tour. All important updates, including driver details, tickets, schedules, and other information, will be shared here.

Our ground team at the destination is also part of this group and will assist you with any on-ground support whenever required.

If you have any questions, doubts, or concerns during the trip, feel free to message in this group. We’re here to help and will do our best to resolve any issues promptly."
However, whenever I had faced difficulties with my booking, immediately I have posted it on this group but nobody from the Tratoli side helped me. They didn't even bother to reply to the group. Their overseas person was good and responsive. But they have never passed on correct information to their overseas partner about what they have promised regarding sightseeing and itinerary. So he was helpless.

After such a blunder, when I asked for the refund of the amount paid towards attractions which were closed or under maintenance and the difference for the service I got and the one which was promised, they only provided false promises and now its  almost about a month, till I have not received my refund for the attractions which were under maintenance and close. They are not even advising amount of refund. They also said that they will give credit note for the amount I paid in forex by credit card to the hotel for an extra bed despite paying the same to Tratoli, they are not giving refunds in cash/bank transfer. For other underated service things and the inconveniences we faced at the destination, they are not ready to compensate. After such a horrible experience who will again dare to travel with them? what's the use of that credit note? This is sheer cheating.
